evidence.notes: identifier/ontology_id CHEBI:9532 -> kgmicrobe.ingredient:0_2_thiamine_pyrophosphate. This record is a 0.2% stock SOLUTION, not the pure compound, and it was holding CHEBI:9532 ('thiamine(1+) diphosphate') — the term the pure-compound record needs. #288 established that stock solutions take a kgmicrobe.ingredient: identifier with FALLBACK_REGISTRY; this applies that rule and frees the ChEBI term. Its recorded CAS 154-87-0 is the chloride's, so that field was never evidence for the ChEBI term either.

evidence.notes: identifier/ontology_id CHEBI:18290 -> CHEBI:9532. ChEBI's live definition of CHEBI:18290 is 'an organic CHLORIDE SALT of thiamine(1+) diphosphate' — a counterion this record's label never mentions. CHEBI:9532 is the compound itself; 'pyrophosphate' and 'diphosphate' are the same moiety under two naming conventions, hence SYNONYM_MATCH. The term was freed by moving the 0.2% stock solution to a minted identifier per #288. The existing SSSOM row already flagged this as 'SYMMETRIC: charge/protonation/ester variant'.
